## 🎯 Type of Change

Please check the applicable options:

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (documentation changes only)
- [ ] 🎨 Code style change (formatting, missing semicolons, etc., no code logic changes)
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactoring (code changes that neither fix a bug nor add a feature)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement (code changes that improve performance)
- [ ] ✅ Test related (adding or modifying tests)
- [ ] 🔧 Build/tooling change (changes affecting build system or external dependencies)
- [ ] 🔒 Security related (security fixes or improvements)

## ✅ Checklist

Before submitting the PR, please ensure:

- [ ] My code follows the project's code style (refer to [CODE_STYLE.md](../docs/enUS/CODE_STYLE.md))
- [ ] I have performed self-code review
- [ ] I have added comments, especially for complex logic
- [ ] My changes do not produce new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests to prove my fix or feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests all pass (`go test ./...`)
- [ ] Code has been formatted (`go fmt ./...`)
- [ ] Code has passed lint checks (`go vet ./...` or `golangci-lint run`)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, etc.)
- [ ] My commit message follows the [commit convention](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-convention)
- [ ] I have checked all changed files to ensure no sensitive information is leaked
